question: Should the 1.0.1 major fixture upgrade require focused source-mode and published-package smoke evidence after rebasing, or are the regenerated compatibility reports sufficient?
rationale: The branch follows the repository’s fixture structure and has no discrete code defect, but repository policy and the large major-version dependency expansion leave the acceptable proof threshold to a human owner.

options.title: Require dual-mode smoke
options.body: Rebase, regenerate reports, and require focused source-mode plus package-mode import and activation evidence before merging.

options.title: Accept generated reports
options.body: After resolving conflicts and refreshing artifacts, accept the zero-hard-breakage dashboard as sufficient fixture evidence.

recommendation.title: Require dual-mode smoke
recommendation.body: Rebase, regenerate reports, and require focused source-mode plus package-mode import and activation evidence before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level fixture validation and release-proof decision rather than an upstream plugin implementation choice.
